About
The
Team

DreamDoor Books is an independent children's imprint in London. Lizzie and Her White-Tipped Tail is our first title.

The Author

Igor Rebenok is a London author and contemporary artist. Lizzie and Her White-Tipped Tail was born from a love of London - its grandeur, its parks, its light on white stucco walls. It is a story about resourcefulness, determination, and finding beauty where others see none.

Alongside his writing, Igor is an exhibiting contemporary artist whose work has been exhibited and donated to charitable causes across London. He believes that creativity and professional life are not opposites, they make each other sharper.

The Illustrator

Henrieta Budde is a Latvian-German artist and illustrator whose work is rooted in the natural world. She runs the independent studio and gallery Budde Art, where she works in oil, acrylic, watercolour, ink and pencil, and creates delicate collages from pressed and dried flowers.

Her paintings are known for their landscapes, floral motifs and whimsical animal portraits - the perfect sensibility for a young fox finding her place in a great city. Lizzie and Her White-Tipped Tail is Henrieta's first children's picture book, bringing her nature-inspired watercolours to the page for the very first time.

Meet the Characters
🦊
Lizzie
A young fox with big dreams and a very resourceful tail. She lives in Hyde Park and refuses to give up.
🐿️
Archie
A cheerful squirrel with shiny eyes and a beautiful home high in the oak tree branches.
🦜
Cecil
A bright green parakeet with flashes of red and gold who swoops through Hyde Park with flair.
🦉
The Owl
A wise old owl who wears a monocle and watches silently from the very top of the oak tree.

Lizzie and Her
White-Tipped Tail

Lizzie is a young fox who is utterly in love with London, but life in the city is tough. Her den is dark, cold and nothing to be proud of. As she explores Hyde Park, she meets Archie the shiny-eyed squirrel, Cecil the parakeet, and a wise old Owl - all living in bright, beautiful homes high above her. Determined and resourceful, Lizzie finds a way to transform her world.
